create_async_checkpointer: create an async context manager that yields a LangGraph checkpointer for FastAPI lifespan management
build_memory_checkpointer: build an InMemorySaver checkpointer when no checkpointer type is configured in config.yaml
build_sqlite_checkpointer: build an async SQLite checkpointer with automatic parent directory creation and connection string resolution
build_postgres_checkpointer: build an async PostgreSQL checkpointer from a connection string with setup and cleanup
review_async_checkpointer: review the internal _async_checkpointer factory that dispatches to memory, sqlite, or postgres backends
